subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF PORTUGAL
text:
U1413/26 NOTAMR U0913/26 
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999 
A)UUUU B)2610160600 C)2701162359 EST E) AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF PORTUGAL 
STIPULATING THAT ANY AIRCRAFT OPERATED BY RUSSIAN AIR CARRIERS, 
INCLUDING MARKETING CARRIERS IN CODE-SHARING OR BLOCKED-SPACE 
ARRANGEMENTS, ANY RUSSIAN REGISTERED AIRCRAFT OR NON-RUSSIAN 
REGISTERED AIRCRAFT WHICH OWNED, CHARTERED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED 
BY ANY RUSSIAN NATURAL PERSON OR LEGAL ENTITY/BODY, ARE PROHIBITED 
TO LAND IN, TAKEOFF FROM OR OVERFLY PORTUGUESE TERRITORY AS PER 
AIP SUP 044/2026, 
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT 
ALL AIRCRAFT OPERATED BY PORTUGUESE AIR CARRIERS INCLUDING 
MARKETING CARRIERS IN CODE-SHARING OR BLOCKED-SPACE ARRANGEMENTS, 
ANY PORTUGUESE REGISTERED OR ANY NON-PORTUGUESE REGISTERED 
AIRCRAFT WHICH OWNED OR CHARTERED, OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY ANY 
PORTUGUESE NATURAL PERSON OR LEGAL ENTITY/BODY ARE PROHIBITED TO 
LAND IN/TAKEOFF FROM/OVERFLY TERRITORY OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR AIRCRAFT IN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN AND MEDICAL 
FLIGHTS AS WELL AS CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT 
OPERATIONS IS GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY 
OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
